supraorbital_contour.lateral_prominence: pronounced lateral extension beyond the ocular margins

macro_zonal_melanin_distribution.regional_intensity_contrast: high contrast between the light-pigmented muzzle/labial region and the dark-pigmented periocular and cheek regions

maxillary_and_labial_geometry.resting_lip_thickness: thick, prominent lower lip with moderate structural droop

other_distinctive_markers: extensive thinning of hair/balding across the frontal and parietal regions of the cranium
